SCO-001.name: Blade Knight
SCO-001.effect: Gains 400 ATK while you have 1 or less cards in your hand. If you control no other monsters, the effects of Flip monsters destroyed by battle with this card are negated.

individual.title: Other monsters you control
individual.text: If you control “Blade Knight” and a face-down monster on your side of the field, “Blade Knight”’s second effect is not applied because you control another monster (whether it is face-up or face-down is not important).

individual.title: Two Blade Knights
individual.text: If you have two “Blade Knights”, then their second effects are not applied because for each one, you have another monster on the field besides the “Blade Knight”.

individual.title: Interaction with Slate Warrior
individual.text: If “Blade Knight” destroys a Flip Effect Monster like “Slate Warrior”, even that monster’s non-Flip effects are negated. So in this case, “Slate Warrior” does not reduce the ATK and DEF of the “Blade Knight” that destroyed it, because “Blade Knight” negates its effect.

individual.title: Interaction with The Immortal of Thunder
individual.text: If “Blade Knight” destroys “The Immortal of Thunder”, its effect is negated. If your opponent had already gained the 3000 Life Points, then your opponent does not lose the 5000 Life Points. If “Blade Knight” attacked “The Immortal of Thunder” while it was face-down, your opponent neither gains nor loses Life Points from “The Immortal of Thunder”’s effect.

individual.title: Interaction with Spear Cretin
individual.text: If “Blade Knight” destroys “Spear Cretin”, “Spear Cretin”’s effect is not applied.

individual.title: Monster is Set again
individual.text: The effect of a Flip Effect monster destroyed by “Blade Knight” is negated while the destroyed card is in the Graveyard. If the monster is Set again on the field, then the Flip Effect is activated when it’s flipped again.

individual.title: Equal ATK and both monsters destroyed
individual.text: If “Blade Knight” attacks a face-down Attack Position Flip Effect Monster with equal ATK, and both monsters are destroyed, then “Blade Knight”’s effect is applied because it destroyed the monster, and the monster’s effect is negated.

SCO-002.name: Black Luster Soldier - Envoy of the Beginning
SCO-002.image: images/cards/Black Luster Soldier - Envoy of the Beginning.jpg
SCO-002.effect:
Cannot be Normal Summoned/Set. Must first be Special Summoned (from your hand) by banishing 1 LIGHT and 1 DARK monster from your GY. Once per turn, you can activate 1 of these effects.

• Target 1 monster on the field; banish it. This card cannot attack the turn this effect is activated.

• If this attacking card destroys an opponent’s monster by battle: It can make a second attack in a row.

individual.title: Different from Black Luster Soldier
individual.text: “Black Luster Soldier - Envoy of the Beginning” is treated as a different card from “Black Luster Soldier”. So you can have 3 copies of “Black Luster Soldier - Envoy of the Beginning” and 3 copies of “Black Luster Soldier” in your Deck & Side Deck combined.

individual.title: Can banish itself
individual.text: “Black Luster Soldier - Envoy of the Beginning” can remove itself from play using its first effect.

individual.title: Effect activation timing
individual.text: The first effect of “Black Luster Soldier - Envoy of the Beginning” can be activated during your Main Phase 1 or 2. The second effect can be activated during your Damage Step in your Battle Phase, and can be chained to.

individual.title: Interaction with Skill Drain
individual.text: If you activate “Black Luster Soldier - Envoy of the Beginning”’s first effect, and “Skill Drain” is chained to it to negate the effect, or if “Skill Drain” was active before you activated the effect, you cannot attack with “Black Luster Soldier - Envoy of the Beginning” that turn because the activation of the effect was not negated and the condition that is included will not be negated by “Skill Drain”.

individual.title: Effect can be used again
individual.text: If you use the first effect of “Black Luster Soldier - Envoy of the Beginning”, then remove him from play and return him to play, or destroy him and Special Summon him again, or flip him face-down then face-up again, you can activate his effect again that same turn.

individual.title: Attack negated
individual.text: If “Black Luster Soldier - Envoy of the Beginning” attacks, and its attack is negated by “Magic Cylinder” or “Negate Attack”, you cannot activate his first effect during Main Phase 2.

individual.title: Cards are banished face-up
individual.text: When a card is removed from play by “Black Luster Soldier - Envoy of the Beginning”’s first effect, it is removed from play face-up.

individual.title: Second attack can be direct
individual.text: If “Black Luster Soldier - Envoy of the Beginning” destroys your opponent’s only monster with his first attack, he can attack your opponent directly for the second attack.

individual.title: Maximum attacks from its own effect
individual.text: If “Black Luster Soldier - Envoy of the Beginning” attacks and destroys your opponent’s monster, then attacks a second time and destroys another monster, it does not get to attack any more that turn.

individual.title: Interaction with Twin Swords of Flashing Light - Tryce
individual.text: Even if you equip him with “Twin Swords of Flashing Light - Tryce”, “Black Luster Soldier - Envoy of the Beginning” only gets a maximum of 2 attacks.

individual.title: Second attack must be consecutive
individual.text: When “Black Luster Soldier - Envoy of the Beginning” conducts a second attack using his second effect, his effect activates during the first attack’s Damage Step, and the attack is declared in the next Battle Step. The second attack must come consecutively after the first attack; other monsters’ attacks cannot come in-between.

SCO-003.name: D.D. Warrior Lady
SCO-003.effect: After damage calculation, when this card battles an opponent’s monster: You can banish that monster, also banish this card.

individual.title: Effect is optional
individual.text: You don’t have to activate “D.D. Warrior Lady”’s effect if you don’t want to.

individual.title: Interaction with Fiber Jar
individual.text: When your “D.D. Warrior Lady” attacks your opponent’s “Fiber Jar”, if you activate her effect then “Fiber Jar” is Step 1 of the chain, because it is mandatory, and “D.D. Warrior Lady” is Step 2 of the chain because it is an optional effect. “D.D. Warrior Lady” removes from play both monsters, and then resolve the effect of “Fiber Jar”. “D.D. Warrior Lady” and “Fiber Jar” are not shuffled into the Deck.

individual.title: Interaction with Wall of Illusion
individual.text: When your “D.D. Warrior Lady” attacks “Wall of Illusion”, if you activate her effect then “Wall of Illusion” is Step 1 of the chain, because it is mandatory, and “D.D. Warrior Lady” is Step 2 of the chain because it is an optional effect. The effect of “D.D. Warrior Lady” removes from play both monsters, then the effect of “Wall of Illusion” disappears, since the attacking monster is no longer on the field.

individual.title: D.D. Warrior Lady vs. D.D. Warrior Lady
individual.text: If your “D.D. Warrior Lady” attacks your opponent’s “D.D. Warrior Lady”, your “D.D. Warrior Lady” is Step 1 of the chain and your opponent’s is Step 2, and when Step 2 resolves, both “D.D. Warrior Lady” cards are removed from play and your “D.D. Warrior Lady”’s effect disappears. This ruling would also apply to attacking “Kelbek”.

netrep.title: Battle damage is not required
netrep.text: Any time “D.D. Warrior Lady” is involved in battle, the controller of “D.D. Warrior Lady” may use its effect, regardless of if it inflicts damage.

netrep.title: Effect negation after battle
netrep.text: If “D.D. Warrior Lady” is destroyed by “Dark Ruler Ha Des”, “Dark Balter the Terrible,” or a monster equipped with “Wicked Breaking Flamberge – Baou,” “D.D. Warrior Lady” will not receive its effect.

netrep.title: Effect does not target
netrep.text: “D.D. Warrior Lady’s” effect is not targeting.

netrep.title: Interaction with Skill Drain
netrep.text: If “Skill Drain” is active when “D.D. Warrior Lady’s” effect resolves, the effect of “D.D. Warrior Lady” is negated.

SCO-004.name: Breaker the Magical Warrior
SCO-004.effect: If this card is Normal Summoned: Place 1 Spell Counter on it (max. 1). Gains 300 ATK for each Spell Counter on it. You can remove 1 Spell Counter from this card, then target 1 Spell/Trap on the field; destroy that target.

individual.title: Spell Counter placement and Trap Hole
individual.text: Placing a Spell Counter on “Breaker, the Magical Warrior” is a chain that begins after it is Summoned. If your opponent chains “Trap Hole” or “Ring of Destruction” to the placement of a Spell Counter on “Breaker, the Magical Warrior”, “Trap Hole” / “Ring of Destruction” resolves before the Spell Counter is placed on “Breaker, the Magical Warrior”, so you cannot chain “Breaker, the Magical Warrior”’s effect.

individual.title: Effect is Spell Speed 1
individual.text: “Breaker, the Magical Warrior”’s effect is Spell Speed 1 so you cannot chain it to the activation of a Spell Card.

individual.title: Using the effect multiple times
individual.text: You can use “Breaker, the Magical Warrior”’s effect multiple times in the same turn as long as you can keep re-supplying him with Spell Counters (using “Pitch-Black Power Stone”, etc.).

individual.title: Removing the Spell Counter is a cost
individual.text: Removing a Spell Counter is a cost; if you remove a Spell Counter from “Breaker, the Magical Warrior” and your opponent chains “Ring of Destruction”, the Spell Counter has already been removed so “Ring of Destruction” deals 1600 damage to each player; “Breaker, the Magical Warrior”’s effect that destroys a card is still applied even though “Breaker, the Magical Warrior” himself has been destroyed at that point.

individual.title: Ring of Destruction during counter placement
individual.text: If I chain “Ring of Destruction” to the placement of a Spell Counter on “Breaker, the Magical Warrior”, “Ring of Destruction” does 1600 damage to each player because the action of placing the Spell Counter has not resolved.

netrep.title: Spell Counter only on Normal Summon
netrep.text: “Breaker the Magical Warrior” only receives its Spell Counter when it is Normal Summoned.

netrep.title: Flip and Special Summon
netrep.text: “Breaker the Magical Warrior” does not get its Spell Counter when it is Flip Summoned or Special Summoned.

netrep.title: Response to Normal Summon
netrep.text: When “Breaker the Magical Warrior” is Normal Summoned, the placement of the Spell Counter is the event to be chained to with “Trap Hole”, “Bottomless Trap Hole,” “Ring of Destruction,” etc.

netrep.title: Removing the counter is a Cost Effect
netrep.text: The removal of the Spell Counter on “Breaker the Magical Warrior” is a Cost Effect. It is Speed 1 and may not be chained to any other effect.

netrep.title: No Spell or Trap on the field
netrep.text: “Breaker the Magical Warrior’s” effect may not be activated if there are no Spell or Trap cards on the field.

SCO-005.name: Asura Priest
SCO-005.effect: Cannot be Special Summoned. During the End Phase of the turn this card is Normal Summoned or flipped face-up: Return it to the hand. This card can attack all monsters your opponent controls once each.

individual.title: Direct attack
individual.text: “Asura Priest” may attack directly if it has not already attacked a monster this turn.

individual.title: Monster appears after a direct attack
individual.text: “Asura Priest” cannot attack a monster if it has already attacked directly this turn. For example, the opponent activates “Call of the Haunted” or “Scapegoat” after “Asura Priest” has completed a direct attack.

individual.title: Each monster only once
individual.text: “Asura Priest” may attack each monster only once. If the opponent controls “Spirit Reaper” you cannot continually attack it.

individual.title: Gravekeeper’s Servant and Toll
individual.text: When cards like “Gravekeeper’s Servant” or “Toll” are active on the field, you must pay each time “Asura Priest” attacks.

individual.title: Resolve each battle separately
individual.text: “Asura Priest” attacks each monster one a time. Resolve the battle with one monster before declaring an attack on another monster.

individual.title: Does not have to attack every monster
individual.text: “Asura Priest” does not have to attack all monsters on your opponent’s side of the field. If you opponent controls 3 monsters, you may choose to attack only 2 of them.

individual.title: Monsters Special Summoned during battle
individual.text: When “Asura Priest” attacks and destroys “Giant Rat” or “Masked Dragon”, you may then attack the monster Special Summoned by the effect of those monsters.

individual.title: Other monsters may attack directly
individual.text: After “Asura Priest” has attacked monsters, other monsters you control may still attack directly.

individual.title: Attacks do not have to be consecutive
individual.text: “Asura Priest” can attack each monster once during the same Battle Phase. These attacks do not have to be all in a row. For example, you can attack monsters with “Asura Priest”, then attack with another monster, and “Asura Priest” can still attack again as long as it attacks a monster it has not attacked yet.

netrep.title: Returning to the hand
netrep.text: “Asura Priest” does not return to the player’s hand if it is not face-up on the field during the End Phase of the turn it was turned face-up.

netrep.title: Direct attack restriction
netrep.text: The ‘you cannot attack your opponent directly’ text on “Asura Priest” refers specifically to an “Asura Priest” that has already attacked a monster on the opponent’s field. If “Asura Priest” has attacked a monster, that “Asura Priest” may not attack Life Points directly.

netrep.title: Separate Battle Steps
netrep.text: Each of “Asura Priest’s” attacks are separate Battle Steps.

SCO-006.name: Don Zaloog

netrep.title: Effect is optional
netrep.text: The effect of “Don Zaloog” is not mandatory.

netrep.title: Attacking or being attacked
netrep.text: “Don Zaloog’s” effect triggers if it inflicts Battle Damage, regardless of if it is attacking or is attacked.

netrep.title: Interaction with Witch of the Black Forest
netrep.text: If “Don Zaloog” attacks and destroys “Witch of the Black Forest” and inflicts Battle Damage, “Don Zaloog’s” effect will resolve first as it triggers on Battle Damage.

SCO-007.name: Exiled Force
SCO-007.effect: By Tributing this face-up card, destroy 1 monster on the field.

individual.title: Only monster on the field
individual.text: You cannot activate the effect of “Exiled Force” if it is the only monster on the field.

netrep.title: Activating immediately upon Summon
netrep.text: “Exiled Force” may activate its effect immediately upon summoning before the opponent may respond to the summoning.

netrep.title: Tributing itself is a cost
netrep.text: Tributing itself is a cost of using “Exiled Force’s” effect.

netrep.title: Spell Speed 1
netrep.text: “Exiled Force” has an activated effect and is Spell Speed 1.

SCO-008.name: Kycoo the Ghost Destroyer
SCO-008.effect: Each time this card inflicts Battle Damage to your opponent’s Life Points, you can remove from play up to 2 Monster Cards in your opponent’s Graveyard. As long as this card remains face-up on the field, your opponent cannot remove from play any cards in either Graveyard.

netrep.title: Cards outside the Graveyard can still be banished
netrep.text: Effects that remove cards from the Field, Hand, or Deck from play may be used if “Kycoo the Ghost Destroyer” is active on the field.

netrep.title: Monster destroyed by battle
netrep.text: If “Kycoo the Ghost Destroyer” destroys a monster and inflicts Battle Damage, the monster destroyed is not an eligible target for “Kycoo the Ghost Destroyer’s” effect.

SCO-009.name: Mystic Swordsman LV2
SCO-009.effect: At the start of the Damage Step, if this card attacked a face-down Defense Position monster: Destroy that monster. During the End Phase, if this card destroyed a monster by battle this turn: You can send this face-up card to the Graveyard; Special Summon 1 “Mystic Swordsman LV4” from your hand or Deck.

individual.title: Destroying a face-down Defense Position monster
individual.text: If “Mystic Swordsman LV2” attacks a face-down Defense Position monster, that monster is destroyed by “Mystic Swordsman LV2”’s effect, not as a result of battle. So you cannot use its second effect to Special Summon “Mystic Swordsman LV4” during the End Phase.

individual.title: Level Up condition can be reset
individual.text: If a level monster fulfills its condition to Special Summon the next-highest level (for example, if “Armed Dragon LV5” destroys a monster as a result of battle), and the level monster is then flipped face-down, or removed from play permanently, or sent to the Graveyard and then Special Summoned from the Graveyard, then its condition is reset and it is no longer considered to have met the condition to level up to the next level.

SCO-010.name: Zombyra the Dark
SCO-010.effect: This card cannot attack your opponent directly. If this card destroys a monster by battle: This card loses 200 ATK.

individual.title: Effect resets when flipped face-down
individual.text: If this monster is flipped face-down its effect is reset (its ATK will again be 2100).

individual.title: Battle damage and direct attacks
individual.text: You can damage your opponent’s Life Points by attacking an opponent’s monster with a lower ATK than “Zombyra the Dark”, but you cannot attack directly with him.

individual.title: Interaction with Dark Spirit of the Silent
individual.text: If “Zombyra the Dark” is the target of “Dark Spirit of the Silent” and your opponent controls no monsters, it may attack directly.

individual.title: Timing of the ATK reduction
individual.text: The reduction in ATK occurs immediately after the opposing monster is destroyed.

netrep.title: Interaction with Shooting Star Bow - Ceal
netrep.text: “Zombyra the Dark” equipped with “Shooting Star Bow - Ceal” may not attack directly.

SCO-011.name: D.D. Assailant
SCO-011.effect: After damage calculation, when this card is destroyed by battle with an opponent's monster: Banish that monster, also banish this card.

SCO-012.name: Book of Moon
SCO-012.effect: Target 1 face-up monster on the field; change that target to face-down Defense Position.

individual.title: Defending monster flipped face-down
individual.text: When you activate “Book of Moon” during the Battle Step to flip your defending monster into face-down Defense Position, the attack resolves as normal. No replay occurs because the possible attack targets on your side of the field did not change.

individual.title: Attacking monster flipped face-down
individual.text: When you activate “Book of Moon” during the Battle Step to flip an attacking monster into face-down Defense Position, the attack stops. No replay is triggered. The attacking monster cannot change its battle position in Main Phase 2, because it is still considered to have declared an attack. (So it cannot be Flip Summoned in Main Phase 2.)

individual.title: Interaction with Mirror Force
individual.text: If you are attacking, and you chain “Book of Moon” to your opponent’s “Mirror Force” to flip one of your monsters face-down, that monster is not destroyed by “Mirror Force”.

individual.title: Magic Cylinder, Ring of Destruction and Trap Hole
individual.text: If you chain “Book of Moon” to “Magic Cylinder”, “Ring of Destruction”, or “Trap Hole” to flip the target of any of those cards face-down, the card’s effect disappears. (See “Activation & Targeting Eligibility” in the Advanced FAQ.)

individual.title: Interaction with Limiter Removal
individual.text: If you use “Book of Moon” on a monster that had its ATK doubled with “Limiter Removal”, the monster is not destroyed at the end of the turn.

individual.title: Interaction with Bottomless Trap Hole
individual.text: If you chain “Book of Moon” to “Bottomless Trap Hole”, the now face-down monster will not be destroyed by “Bottomless Trap Hole”, but any other appropriate monsters Summoned at the same time will still be destroyed.

individual.title: Interaction with Dream Clown
individual.text: If you use “Book of Moon” on “Dream Clown”, “Dream Clown”’s effect is not activated.

individual.title: Chaining to a Flip Effect
individual.text: If you chain “Book of Moon” to the activation of a Flip Effect Monster’s effect, such as “Fiber Jar”, “Book of Moon” flips the monster face-down again, but the Flip Effect still resolves as normal.

individual.title: Monster Tokens
individual.text: You cannot flip a Monster Token face-down because Monster Tokens are always face-up.

individual.title: Interaction with Light of Intervention
individual.text: You cannot activate “Book of Moon” while “Light of Intervention” is active.

netrep.title: Book of Moon on a defending monster
netrep.text: If “Book of Moon” is activated on a defending monster, the attack resolves as normal.

netrep.title: Book of Moon on an attacking monster
netrep.text: If “Book of Moon” resolves on an attacking monster, the attack stops at that point. The Damage Step is not reached at that point.

netrep.title: No Replay when turned face-down
netrep.text: A monster turned face-down by the effect of “Book of Moon” in response to the declaration of an attack does not trigger a Replay.

netrep.title: Effects requiring face-up targets
netrep.text: Effects that require face-up targets will have their effects disappear if “Book of Moon” is chained and successfully resolves to them. This includes “Mirror Force,” “Magic Cylinder,” and “Ring of Destruction.”

netrep.title: Continuous Effects
netrep.text: Monsters with Continuous effects have their effects cease when turned face-down by “Book of Moon.”

netrep.title: Monster effects are reset
netrep.text: Monsters that are turned face down by “Book of Moon” have their effects reset. This includes “Suijin,” which will be allowed to use its effect again when turned face up.

netrep.title: Interaction with Flip Effects
netrep.text: If “Book of Moon” is chained to a Flip effect, the Flip effect will resolve as normally unless the Flip effect requires the monster to remain face-up.

netrep.title: Tokens cannot be turned face-down
netrep.text: Tokens may not be turned face down by “Book of Moon.”

netrep.title: Interaction with Call of the Haunted
netrep.text: If a monster Special Summoned with “Call of the Haunted” is turned face-down by “Book of Moon,” that monster will remain on the field and “Call of the Haunted” will remain face-up on the field meaninglessly.

netrep.title: Interaction with Change of Heart
netrep.text: If a monster that changes control via “Change of Heart” is turned face-down by “Book of Moon,” the monster will return to the original controller’s field when the turn ends as normal per “Change of Heart.”

netrep.title: Interaction with Premature Burial
netrep.text: If a monster Special Summoned and Equipped with “Premature Burial” is turned face-down by “Book of Moon,” that monster will remain on the field and “Premature Burial” will be sent to the Graveyard as it no longer has a legal target.

netrep.title: Interaction with Snatch Steal
netrep.text: If a monster equipped with “Snatch Steal” is turned face-down by “Book of Moon”, “Snatch Steal” will be sent to the Graveyard as it no longer has a legal target and control of that monster will remain with the controller of “Snatch Steal.”

SCO-013.name: Delinquent Duo
SCO-013.effect: Pay 1000 Life Points. Your opponent randomly selects and discards 1 card from his/her hand and then selects and discards another card from his/her hand.

individual.title: Opponent has only 1 card
individual.text: This card may be activated if your opponent has only 1 card in his/her hand.

netrep.title: Effect must fully resolve before discarded card effects
netrep.text: If the first card discarded by the effect of “Delinquent Duo” has an effect that activates on being discarded or sent to the Graveyard, “Delinquent Duo’s” effect must still fully resolve before the new effect begins a new Chain.

individual.title: Interaction with Appropriate
individual.text: Your opponent cannot activate “Appropriate” after you activate “Graceful Charity” since the last effect that resolves with “Graceful Charity” is discarding, not drawing, and your opponent misses the timing. But if your opponent already has an active “Appropriate” face-up on the field, he/she can draw 2 cards after you activate “Graceful Charity”.

individual.title: Solemn Wishes and Skull Invitation
individual.text: If “Solemn Wishes” is on the field when you activate “Graceful Charity”, you gain 500 Life Points after you finish both drawing and discarding. If “Solemn Wishes” and “Skull Invitation” are on the field, you finish both drawing and discarding for the effect of “Graceful Charity” then you gain 500 Life Points, then you lose 600 Life Points.

individual.title: Interaction with Exodia
individual.text: If you have three pieces of Exodia in your hand, “Graceful Charity”, and no other cards, and then you activate “Graceful Charity” and draw the final 2 pieces of Exodia, you must discard 2 cards before a victory can be declared, but after you discard you will no longer have all 5 pieces of Exodia, and cannot declare a victory.

SCO-015.name: Heavy Storm
SCO-015.effect: Destroy all Spell and Trap Cards on the field.

netrep.title: Field Spell Cards
netrep.text: “Heavy Storm” does destroy Field Spell Cards.

SCO-016.name: Mystical Space Typhoon
SCO-016.effect: Target 1 Spell/Trap on the field; destroy that target.

netrep.title: Can be activated in any phase
netrep.text: “Mystical Space Typhoon” may be activated in any phase.

netrep.title: Cannot be activated during the Damage Step
netrep.text: “Mystical Space Typhoon” may not be activated during the Damage Step.

netrep.title: Targeting effect
netrep.text: “Mystical Space Typhoon” is a targeting effect.

netrep.title: Interaction with Call of the Haunted
netrep.text: If “Mystical Space Typhoon” is activated in a chain with the activation of “Call of the Haunted,” “Mystical Space Typhoon” will destroy the “Call of the Haunted” before “Call of the Haunted” Special Summons a monster. “Call of the Haunted’s” effect will then disappear. If “Call of the Haunted” is activated in a chain with a “Mystical Space Typhoon” that targets “Call of the Haunted,” “Call of the Haunted” will resolve first, Special Summoning a monster. “Mystical Space Typhoon” will then resolve destroying the “Call of the Haunted.” If “Call of the Haunted” is not negated at this point, the monster Special Summoned by “Call of the Haunted” will be destroyed.

SCO-017.name: Nobleman of Crossout
SCO-017.effect: Destroy 1 face-down monster and remove it from play. If the monster is a Flip Effect Monster, both players must check their respective Decks and remove all monsters of the same name from play. Then shuffle the Decks.

individual.title: Flip Effects are not activated
individual.text: If the targeted monster is a Flip Effect Monster, it is not flipped face-up and its Flip Effect is not activated. Both players must reveal their Decks to each other to verify that all cards of the same name as the Flip Effect Monster are removed from play.

individual.title: Cards never go to the Graveyard
individual.text: The targeted monster, and any cards of the same name if the target was a Flip Effect Monster, are removed from play and never go to the Graveyard, so the effects of cards like “Sangan” will not activate.

individual.title: Cards in the hand or on the field
individual.text: Cards of the same name in your hand or on the field are NOT removed from play.

SCO-019.name: Premature Burial
SCO-019.effect: Activate this card by paying 800 LP, then target 1 monster in your Graveyard; Special Summon that target in Attack Position and equip it with this card. When this card is destroyed, destroy the equipped monster.

individual.title: Interaction with Tailor of the Fickle
individual.text: You cannot activate “Tailor of the Fickle” selecting “Premature Burial” as a target.

individual.title: Interaction with Fairy’s Hand Mirror
individual.text: You cannot activate “Fairy’s Hand Mirror” to make your opponent chose a different monster when they activate “Premature Burial”.

individual.title: Interaction with Imperial Order
individual.text: If you activate this card and your opponent chains “Imperial Order” the effect of “Premature Burial” is negated and the Special Summon never occurs, but you still pay 800 Life Points. If “Imperial Order” is activated after “Premature Burial” is already on the field, the equipped monster is NOT destroyed and “Premature Burial” remains on the field meaninglessly. If “Premature Burial” is then destroyed while “Imperial Order” is still active, the monster remains on the field, but if the monster is destroyed, “Premature Burial” is also destroyed, since it is still equipped to that monster.

individual.title: Equipped monster is flipped face-down
individual.text: If the equipped monster is flipped face-down “Premature Burial” is destroyed but the monster is not destroyed.

netrep.title: Targeting effect
netrep.text: “Premature Burial” is a targeting effect targeting a card in the Graveyard.

netrep.title: Interaction with Necrovalley
netrep.text: An already active “Premature Burial” is not negated when a “Necrovalley” is newly activated.

SCO-020.name: Reinforcement of the Army
SCO-020.effect: Add 1 Level 4 or lower Warrior monster from your Deck to your hand.

individual.title: Selected monster must be revealed
individual.text: You must reveal the monster you select with this card’s effect to your opponent before placing it in your hand.

individual.title: No valid Warrior remaining in the Deck
individual.text: You can activate this card even if you have no Level 4 or lower Warrior-Type monsters remaining in your Deck, but you must let your opponent see your Deck to confirm. Shuffle your Deck afterwards.

SCO-021.name: Snatch Steal
SCO-021.effect: Take control of a monster on your opponent’s side of the field that is equipped with this card. Increase your opponent’s Life Points by 1000 points during each of their Standby Phases.

individual.title: Interaction with Different Dimension Gate
individual.text: When your opponent’s monster on your side of the field that you control with “Change of Heart” or “Snatch Steal” is removed with “Different Dimension Gate”, it returns to your side of the field when “Different Dimension Gate” is destroyed, and then immediately returns to your opponent’s side of the field.

individual.title: Interaction with Gearfried the Swordmaster
individual.text: If your opponent equips “Snatch Steal” to your “Gearfried the Swordmaster”, the effect of “Snatch Steal” resolves first and control changes. Then the effect of “Gearfried the Swordmaster” activates and your opponent gets to select which monster is destroyed.

individual.title: Interaction with Interdimensional Matter Transporter
individual.text: If you control your opponent’s monster because of “Change of Heart” or “Snatch Steal”, and remove the monster with “Interdimensional Matter Transporter”, the monster returns to your side of the field, then immediately returns to your opponent’s side of the field.

individual.title: Interaction with Ojama Trio
individual.text: When your opponent activates “Snatch Steal”, and you chain “Ojama Trio” to fill up his/her remaining Monster Zones, then there is no room for the stolen monster, and it is destroyed.

individual.title: Interaction with Remove Brainwashing
individual.text: When “Snatch Steal” is active, the +1000 Life Points effect is applied even if “Remove Brainwashing” has returned control of the monster to the original owner.

netrep.title: Multiple copies of Snatch Steal
netrep.text: If more than one “Snatch Steal” is equipped to the same monster, the later “Snatch Steal” will take precedence for purposes of determining control.

netrep.title: Snatch Steal leaves the field
netrep.text: If “Snatch Steal” leaves the field, the monster equipped with “Snatch Steal” will return to the control of the previous controller.

netrep.title: Equipped monster is turned face-down
netrep.text: If the monster equipped with “Snatch Steal” is turned face-down, “Snatch Steal” will be sent to the Graveyard and the monster will remain under the control of the controller of “Snatch Steal.”

netrep.title: Interaction with Creature Swap
netrep.text: If a monster equipped with “Snatch Steal” changes control via “Creature Swap,” “Snatch Steal” will remain equipped to the original monster, but control will not shift back. The opponent of the controller of “Snatch Steal” will continue to regain 1000 LP per Standby Phase as long as “Snatch Steal” remains on the field.

SCO-022.name: Call of the Haunted
SCO-022.effect: Activate this card by targeting 1 monster in your GY; Special Summon that target in Attack Position. When this card leaves the field, destroy that monster. When that monster is destroyed, destroy this card.

netrep.title: Targeting effect
netrep.text: “Call of the Haunted” constitutes a targeting effect.

netrep.title: Target must be declared at activation
netrep.text: The player using “Call of the Haunted” must declare the monster to be Special Summoned at the time of activation.

netrep.title: Monster sent to the Graveyard without being destroyed
netrep.text: If the monster Special Summoned by “Call of the Haunted” is sent to the Graveyard, but not destroyed, “Call of the Haunted” remains on the field meaninglessly.

netrep.title: Monster returned to the hand
netrep.text: If the monster Special Summoned by “Call of the Haunted” is returned to the hand, “Call of the Haunted” remains on the field meaninglessly.

netrep.title: Monster is Tributed
netrep.text: If the monster Special Summoned by “Call of the Haunted” is Tributed, “Call of the Haunted” remains on the field meaninglessly.

netrep.title: Target no longer in the Graveyard
netrep.text: If that monster is not in the Graveyard at the time of resolution, “Call of the Haunted” resolves without effect and remains on the field meaninglessly.

netrep.title: Activation during the Battle Phase
netrep.text: “Call of the Haunted” may be used to Special Summon a monster from the Graveyard during either player’s Battle Phase. If “Call of the Haunted” is successfully resolved during the opponent’s Battle Phase as a response to an attack declaration, a Replay is triggered.

netrep.title: Cannot be activated during the Damage Step
netrep.text: “Call of the Haunted” may not be activated during the Damage Step.

netrep.title: Destroyed in a Chain to its activation
netrep.text: If “Call of the Haunted” is destroyed in a chain to the activation of “Call of the Haunted,” the monster that would be Special Summoned by “Call of the Haunted” is not Special Summoned.

netrep.title: Interaction with Gearfried the Iron Knight
netrep.text: “Call of the Haunted” does not equip itself to “Gearfried the Iron Knight.” “Gearfried the Iron Knight” can be successfully summoned by “Call of the Haunted.”

netrep.title: Interaction with Jinzo
netrep.text: “Call of the Haunted” can Special Summon “Jinzo.” If “Call of the Haunted” is destroyed while “Jinzo” is face-up on the field, the monster targeted by “Call of the Haunted” will not be destroyed. If “Jinzo” is Special Summoned by “Call of the Haunted” and “Jinzo” is destroyed, “Call of the Haunted” is destroyed.

netrep.title: Interaction with Monster Reborn
netrep.text: If the opponent plays “Monster Reborn” targeting a specific monster in a player’s Graveyard, and “Call of the Haunted” is chained to the activation of “Monster Reborn” targeting the same monster, “Call of the Haunted” will resolve first removing that monster from the Graveyard. “Monster Reborn” will resolve without effect.

netrep.title: Interaction with Mystical Space Typhoon
netrep.text: If “Mystical Space Typhoon” is activated in a chain with the activation of “Call of the Haunted,” “Mystical Space Typhoon” will destroy the “Call of the Haunted” before “Call of the Haunted” Special Summons a monster. “Call of the Haunted’s” effect will then disappear. If “Call of the Haunted” is activated in a chain with a “Mystical Space Typhoon” that targets “Call of the Haunted,” “Call of the Haunted” will resolve first, Special Summoning a monster. “Mystical Space Typhoon” will then resolve destroying the “Call of the Haunted.” If “Call of the Haunted” is not negated at this point, the monster Special Summoned by “Call of the Haunted” will be destroyed.

netrep.title: Interaction with Tyrant Dragon
netrep.text: If “Call of the Haunted” is used to Special Summon “Tyrant Dragon” and resolves successfully, “Call of the Haunted” will be negated and destroyed after “Tyrant Dragon” has been Special Summoned. “Tyrant Dragon” will remain on the field.

netrep.title: Interaction with Union monsters
netrep.text: If a Union monster like “Koitsu” is Special Summoned by “Call of the Haunted” and then uses its effect to equip itself to its Union counterpart, “Call of the Haunted” will no longer affect the Union monster and will remain face-up on the field meaninglessly.

SCO-023.name: Dust Tornado
SCO-023.effect: Destroy 1 Spell or Trap Card on your opponent’s side of the field. You can then Set 1 Spell or Trap Card from your hand.

individual.title: Setting a Spell or Trap Card
individual.text: You must destroy 1 Spell or Trap Card on your opponent’s side of the field to be able to Set 1 Spell or Trap Card. If your opponent chains a card to destroy the target of “Dust Tornado”, you cannot then Set a Spell or Trap Card because “Dust Tornado” did not destroy a Spell or Trap Card. If your opponent activates the card targeted by “Dust Tornado” it is not negated, but is still destroyed by “Dust Tornado” so you may Set 1 Spell or Trap Card.

netrep.title: Activating a Spell Card Set by Dust Tornado
netrep.text: A non Quick-play Spell Card set by the effect of “Dust Tornado” during that player’s Turn may be activated during that player’s Main Phase 1 or Main Phase 2.

netrep.title: Interaction with Harpies’ Feather Duster and Heavy Storm
netrep.text: If “Dust Tornado” is chained to “Harpies’ Feather Duster” or “Heavy Storm,” and “Dust Tornado’s” second effect of Setting a Spell or Trap Card is used, that Spell or Trap card will be subject to the effect of “Harpie’s Feather Duster” or “Heavy Storm.”

SCO-024.name: Mirror Force
SCO-024.effect: You can only activate this card when your opponent’s monster declares an attack. Destroy all Attack Position monsters on your opponent’s side of the field.

netrep.title: Does not target
netrep.text: “Mirror Force” is not a targeting effect, regardless of the number of monsters it destroys.

netrep.title: Monsters removed or turned face-down
netrep.text: Monsters turned face down or removed from the field in a chain with “Mirror Force” are not destroyed.

SCO-025.name: Ring of Destruction
SCO-025.effect: Target 1 face-up monster on the field; destroy that target, and if you do, inflict damage to both players equal to that target’s ATK.

individual.title: Cannot be activated during the Damage Step
individual.text: You cannot activate “Ring of Destruction” during the Damage Step.

individual.title: Damage is based on current ATK
individual.text: “Ring of Destruction” inflicts damage based on the current (total) ATK value, NOT the original ATK.

individual.title: Targeting effect
individual.text: This card targets a monster.

individual.title: Interaction with Magic Cylinder
individual.text: If you chain “Ring of Destruction” to “Magic Cylinder”, “Magic Cylinder”’s effect disappears because the monster is no longer there (so “Magic Cylinder” inflicts no damage).

individual.title: Interaction with Witch of the Black Forest
individual.text: If a player Tributes “Witch of the Black Forest” for “Summoned Skull”, you can chain “Ring of Destruction” to the effect of “Witch of the Black Forest”, in order to destroy “Summoned Skull”. If this reduces the player’s Life Points to zero, then they cannot use “Witch of the Black Forest”’s effect (to retrieve a 5th Exodia piece, for example).

SCO-026.name: Sakuretsu Armor
SCO-026.effect: When an opponent’s monster declares an attack: Target the attacking monster; destroy that target.

individual.title: Targeting effect
individual.text: “Sakuretsu Armor” targets 1 monster.

individual.title: Interaction with Book of Moon
individual.text: If the turn player chains “Book of Moon” to “Sakuretsu Armor” to flip the attacking monster face-down, then the attacking monster is not destroyed by “Sakuretsu Armor”.

SCO-027.name: Solemn Judgment
SCO-027.effect: Pay half of your Life Points. Negate an activation of a Spell / Trap Card / Normal Summon / Flip Summon / Special Summon and destroy the Spell Card, Trap Card, or Summoned monster.

netrep.title: Special Summons from card effects
netrep.text: “Solemn Judgment” can not be used to negate a Special Summon if that Special Summon occurs as a result of another card effect.

netrep.title: Negated Special Summon monsters
netrep.text: Special Summon monsters like “Dark Necrofear” that have their summons negated by “Solemn Judgment” are not considered properly summoned and may not be Special Summoned from the Graveyard.

SCO-028.name: Torrential Tribute
SCO-028.effect: When a monster(s) is Summoned: Destroy all monsters on the field.

individual.title: Activation after a Summon
individual.text: “Torrential Tribute” is activated after a monster is Summoned; it is not chained to the Summon. So you cannot activate “Torrential Tribute” when “Jinzo” is Summoned.

individual.title: Summons through another card’s effect
individual.text: “Torrential Tribute” can be activated after a monster is Summoned through another card’s effect, such as “Monster Reborn”, “Scapegoat”, “Cyber Jar” (if Flip Summoned), or “Call of the Haunted”.

individual.title: Activation after a Flip Summon
individual.text: “Torrential Tribute” can be activated after a Flip Summon, but it does not negate the Flip Effect (it is chained to the Flip Effect).

individual.title: Cannot be activated during the Damage Step
individual.text: “Torrential Tribute” cannot be activated during the Damage Step. This prohibits “Torrential Tribute” from being used against monsters Special Summoned by “Mystic Tomato”, “Giant Rat”, “Nimble Momonga”, “Masked Dragon”, and other such cards that Special Summon a monster when destroyed as a result of battle, as well as “Cyber Jar” or “Morphing Jar #2” that is flipped face-up by an attack.

SCO-029.name: Trap Dustshoot
SCO-029.effect: You can only activate this card when your opponent has 4 or more cards in their hand. Look at your opponent’s hand, then select 1 Monster Card and return it to its owners’s Deck. Then shuffle the Deck.

individual.title: Interaction with Exchange
individual.text: You can select your own card that was taken by your opponent with “Exchange”. The card returns to the owner’s deck (yours, in this case).

SCO-030.name: Ninja Grandmaster Sasuke
SCO-030.effect: At the start of the Damage Step, if this card attacks a face-up Defense Position monster: Destroy that monster.

individual.title: Interaction with a face-down Defense Position monster
individual.text: “Ninja Grandmaster Sasuke”’s effect activates at the beginning of the Damage Step, before the monster is flipped face-up. So if “Ninja Grandmaster Sasuke” attacks a face-down Defense Position monster, “Ninja Grandmaster Sasuke” will not destroy it with his effect because it is not flipped face-up until after “Ninja Grandmaster Sasuke”’s effect would activate.

individual.title: Interaction with Spirit Reaper
individual.text: A face-up Defense Position “Spirit Reaper” will be destroyed by the effect of “Ninja Grandmaster Sasuke”. “Ninja Grandmaster Sasuke”’s effect does not target. So if “Ninja Grandmaster Sasuke” attacks “Spirit Reaper”, “Spirit Reaper” is destroyed by “Ninja Grandmaster Sasuke”’s effect, not by “Spirit Reaper”’s effect.

individual.title: Interaction with D.D. Warrior Lady
individual.text: If “Ninja Grandmaster Sasuke” attacks a face-up Defense Position “D.D. Warrior Lady”, “D.D. Warrior Lady” is destroyed by the effect of “Ninja Grandmaster Sasuke” and “D.D. Warrior Lady”’s effect is not activated.

individual.title: Interaction with Book of Moon
individual.text: If “Ninja Grandmaster Sasuke” attacks a face-up Defense Position monster, and you flip it face-down during the Battle Step with “Book of Moon”, the monster is face-down at the start of the Damage Step so “Ninja Grandmaster Sasuke” will not destroy it with his effect.

individual.title: Interaction with Ceasefire
individual.text: If “Ninja Grandmaster Sasuke” attacks a face-down Defense Position monster, and “Ceasefire” is activated during the Battle Step, the monster is face-up at the start of the Damage Step so it will be destroyed by “Ninja Grandmaster Sasuke”’s effect.

SCO-031.name: King Tiger Wanghu
SCO-031.effect: When a monster(s) with 1400 or less ATK is Normal Summoned or Special Summoned: Destroy those monsters with 1400 or less ATK. This card must be face-up on the field to activate and to resolve this effect.

individual.title: Monsters already on the field
individual.text: Monsters with ATK 1400 or less that are already on the field when “King Tiger Wanghu” is Summoned are not destroyed. “King Tiger Wanghu”’s effect only applies to monsters Summoned while it is face-up on the field.

individual.title: Flip Summons and monsters flipped face-up
individual.text: When a monster is Flip Summoned or flipped face-up by a card effect, it is not destroyed by the effect of “King Tiger Wanghu”.

individual.title: Both sides of the field
individual.text: “King Tiger Wanghu”’s effect applies to both sides of the field.

individual.title: Interaction with Cyber Jar
individual.text: When “King Tiger Wanghu” is Special Summoned by the effect of “Cyber Jar”, other monsters with ATK 1400 or less that are Special Summoned by the same “Cyber Jar” are destroyed if they are Special Summoned in face-up Attack Position.

individual.title: ATK modifiers when a monster is Summoned
individual.text: If a monster’s ATK when it is Summoned is less than 1400 due to the effect of other cards, such as a Field Spell Card that reduces its ATK, it is destroyed by “King Tiger Wanghu”’s effect (so apply all existing modifiers before determining if the monster is destroyed). If “Command Knight” is Summoned, it increases its own ATK to 1600 before “King Tiger Wanghu” can destroy it.

individual.title: King Tiger Wanghu destroys itself
individual.text: If “King Tiger Wanghu” is Normal Summoned or Special Summoned, and its own ATK is reduced below 1400 by a pre-existing effect, then it destroys itself when Summoned. Example: “King Tiger Wanghu” and “Bladefly” are Special Summoned simultaneously by “Cyber Jar”. “King Tiger Wanghu”’s ATK is 1300, and it is destroyed by its own effect (and “Bladefly” is also destroyed by “King Tiger Wanghu”’s effect).

individual.title: Monsters Summoned face-down
individual.text: Monsters that are Summoned face-down (like with “The Shallow Grave”) are not destroyed by King Tiger Wanghu.

individual.title: Monster Tokens
individual.text: “King Tiger Wanghu”’s effect includes Monster Tokens with ATK 1400 or less.

individual.title: Interaction with Marauding Captain
individual.text: If “King Tiger Wanghu” is on the field and “Marauding Captain” is Summoned, “Marauding Captain” can still activate its effect and Special Summon a monster even though “Marauding Captain” is destroyed.

individual.title: Simultaneous Trigger Effects
individual.text: If “King Tiger Wanghu” is on the field along with Trigger Effect monsters such as “Mysterious Puppeteer”, “Ryu-Kishin Clown”, “Sonic Bird”, and “Dragon Seeker”, then they form a chain.

individual.title: Interaction with Exiled Force
individual.text: If “King Tiger Wanghu” is on the field, and “Exiled Force” is Summoned, “King Tiger Wanghu”’s effect immediately activates. Since “Exiled Force” cannot be chained, “King Tiger Wanghu” will destroy “Exiled Force” before the turn player can Tribute “Exiled Force” using its effect.

netrep.title: Interaction with Gyaku-Gire Panda
netrep.text: If “Gyaku-Gire Panda” is Summoned while “King Tiger Wanghu” is on the field, “Gyaku-Gire Panda” will not be destroyed if the opponent has enough monsters (2 or more in this case) to raise the ATK of “Gyaku-Gire Panda” above the 1400 ATK threshold.

netrep.title: Interaction with Tsukuyomi
netrep.text: If “Tsukuyomi” is Summoned while “King Tiger Wanghu” is on the field, “Tsukuyomi” and “King Tiger Wanghu” will trigger at the same time. Since the turn player is Summoning “Tsukuyomi”, it will be CL1 and “King Tiger Wanghu” will be CL2. This will result in “King Tiger Wanghu” destroying “Tsukuyomi” and then the effect of “Tsukuyomi” will resolve flipping the target face-down. If the player who is Summoning “Tsukuyomi” is the same player who controls “King Tiger Wanghu”, that player can choose the order the effects are activated in since they are both mandatory effects that happen at the same time. The player can choose to have “King Tiger Wanghu” be CL1 and “Tsukuyomi” be CL2. This will result in “Tsukuyomi” resolving first and flipping “King Tiger Wanghu” face-down. In this example, “Tsukuyomi” would live because “King Tiger Wanghu” must be face-up on the field for its effect to resolve.

SCO-032.name: Mind Control
SCO-032.effect: Target 1 monster your opponent controls; until the End Phase, take control of that target, but it cannot declare an attack or be Tributed.

individual.title: Control and a monster flipped face-down
individual.text: The effect of “Mind Control” that prevents the targeted monster from attacking or being Tributed lasts until the End Phase of the turn “Mind Control” was activated, even if the monster is flipped face-down before the End Phase. If the monster targeted with this card is flipped face-down, it will still return to the original owner’s side of the field during the End Phase.

netrep.title: Judge List: Tributing the controlled monster
netrep.text:
The monster you take control of with “Mind Control” cannot be Tributed. You cannot Tribute it to Summon a high-level monster. You cannot Tribute it with “Metamorphosis.” You cannot Tribute it for “Enemy Controller.” You cannot Tribute it with “Share the Pain.” You cannot Tribute it with “Cannon Soldier.”

Curtis Schultz, 02/20/2005

SCO-033.name: Mobius the Frost Monarch
SCO-033.effect: When this card is Tribute Summoned: You can target up to 2 Spell/Trap Cards on the field; destroy those targets.

individual.title: Selecting Spell / Trap Cards
individual.text: You select the Spell / Trap Cards when you activate the effect of “Mobius the Frost Monarch”.

individual.title: Targeting
individual.text: This effect targets.

individual.title: Interaction with Level Limit - Area B
individual.text: If “Level Limit - Area B” is active and “Mobius the Frost Monarch” is successfully Tribute Summoned, “Level Limit - Area B” is a Continuous Spell Card so its effect is applied and the battle position of “Mobius the Frost Monarch” is changed to Defense Position. Then you can activate the effect of “Mobius the Frost Monarch”.

individual.title: Interaction with Ultimate Offering
individual.text: If “Mobius the Frost Monarch” is Tribute Summoned by the effect of “Ultimate Offering” in the middle of a chain (and is not the last step of the chain to resolve), then you have missed the timing on his effect and you cannot activate his effect to destroy 2 Spell or Trap Cards.

individual.title: A target destroyed before resolution
individual.text: If 1 of the 2 Spell or Trap Cards targeted by the effect of “Mobius the Frost Monarch” is destroyed by some card effect before his effect resolves, the remaining 1 card is still destroyed by his effect.

SCO-034.name: Xing Zhen Hu
SCO-034.effect: Activate by selecting 2 Set Spell or Trap Cards on the field. The selected Spell or Trap Cards cannot be activated.

individual.title: Chaining a selected Spell / Trap Card
individual.text: You can chain one of the 2 Spell or Trap Cards on the field to the activation of “Xing Zhen Hu”. However, the remaining one will not be able to be activated after “Xing Zhen Hu” resolves.

individual.title: Neither target remains on the field
individual.text: If neither of the targeted Spell or Trap Cards is on the field when “Xing Zhen Hu” resolves, then “Xing Zhen Hu” remains on the field meaninglessly.

SCO-035.name: Smashing Ground
SCO-035.effect: Destroy the 1 face-up monster your opponent controls with the highest DEF (your choice, if tied).

SCO-036.name: Mystik Wok
SCO-036.effect: Tribute 1 monster. Select either its ATK or DEF and gain that many Life Points.

individual.title: Tributing as a cost
individual.text: Tributing a monster for “Mystik Wok” is a cost, so you can Tribute “The Legendary Fisherman” or “The Agent of Force - Mars”.

individual.title: Current ATK or DEF
individual.text: The ATK or DEF is the current number, not the original number.

individual.title: Selecting ATK or DEF
individual.text: You select ATK or DEF when “Mystik Wok” is activated.

individual.title: Eligible monsters
individual.text: You can Tribute face-down monsters, or your opponent’s monster using “Soul Exchange”.

SCO-037.name: Morphing Jar
SCO-037.effect: FLIP: Both players discard as many cards as possible from their hands, then each player draws 5 cards.

individual.title: Drawing with fewer than 5 cards
individual.text: If there are fewer than 5 cards in the Deck of either player when this card’s Flip Effect is activated, that player will lose the Duel, since the text of this card says “draw”.

SCO-038.name: Brain Control
SCO-038.effect: Pay 800 LP, then target 1 face-up monster your opponent controls; take control of that target until the End Phase.

individual.title: Face-down target later in the turn
individual.text: If the monster targeted by “Brain Control” is flipped face-down later in the turn, it is still returned back to the original controller in the End Phase.

individual.title: No free Monster Zone
individual.text: You cannot activate “Brain Control” if you already have 5 monsters on your side of the field.

netrep.title: Judge List: Book of Moon chained
netrep.text: If “Book of Moon” is chained to “Brain Control,” turning the target of “Brain Control” face-down, the effect of “Brain Control” would disappear and the targeted monster will remain where it is.

netrep.title: Other Ruling: Temporarily removed from play
netrep.text: If the monster affected by “Change of Heart” is temporarily removed from play, that monster will return to the original controller when the monster returns to play.

netrep.title: Other Ruling: Blindly Loyal Goblin
netrep.text: A face-up “Blindly Loyal Goblin” may not be targeted by “Change of Heart.” If a face-down “Blindly Loyal Goblin” changes control through the effect of “Change of Heart” or similar cards and “Blindly Loyal Goblin” is turned face-up, control of “Blindly Loyal Goblin” will not return to the original controller.

SCO-039.name: Thousand-Eyes Restrict
SCO-039.effect: As long as this card remains face-up on the field, other monsters cannot change their battle positions or attack. Select 1 monster on your opponent’s side of the field and equip it to this card (this effect can only be used once per turn and you can only equip 1 monster at a time to this card). The ATK and DEF of this card become the same amounts as the monster equipped to this card. If this card is destroyed as a result of battle, the equipped monster is destroyed instead.

netrep.title: Equipping a monster
netrep.text: “Thousand-Eyes Restrict” may equip itself with 1 monster at a time per turn.

netrep.title: Targeting
netrep.text: “Thousand-Eyes Restrict”’s equipping effect is a targeting effect.

netrep.title: Status of equipped monsters
netrep.text: Monsters equipped to “Thousand-Eyes Restrict” do not have effects and are treated as Equip Spell Cards.

netrep.title: Manually changing battle positions
netrep.text: Monsters may not have their positions manually changed while “Thousand-Eyes Restrict” is on the field.

netrep.title: Changing battle positions by card effect
netrep.text: Monsters may change their position through a card effect while “Thousand-Eyes Restrict” is on the field.

netrep.title: Two Thousand-Eyes Restricts
netrep.text: If 2 “Thousand-Eyes Restricts” are on the field, no monster may attack.

netrep.title: Interaction with Imperial Order
netrep.text: “Imperial Order” has no effect on “Thousand-Eyes Restrict” as “Thousand-Eyes Restrict” determines its ATK and DEF.

netrep.title: Witch of the Black Forest
netrep.text: If a “Witch of the Black Forest” is equipped to “Thousand-Eyes Restrict” and sent to the Graveyard, the effect of “Witch of the Black Forest” will activate.

judge.title: Nobleman of Extermination
judge.text: A face-down card equipped to “Relinquished” or “Thousand-Eyes Restrict” is a legal target for “Nobleman of Extermination.” — Curtis Schultz, 03/09/2005

judge.title: Byser Shock
judge.text: A face-down card equipped to “Relinquished” or “Thousand-Eyes Restrict” will be returned to its owner’s hand by “Byser Shock”’s effect. — Curtis Schultz, 03/09/2005

questions.title: Ring of Destruction chained to the equipping effect
questions.text: If “Thousand-Eyes Restrict” targets an opponent’s “Gemini Elf” with its effect, the opponent can chain “Ring of Destruction” and destroy the targeted “Gemini Elf”. “Ring of Destruction” can also target and destroy “Thousand-Eyes Restrict”, in which case it cannot resolve its effect properly. — Curtis Schultz, 02/18/2004

other.title: Thousand-Eyes Restrict is flipped face-down or removed
other.text: If “Book of Moon”, “Ring of Destruction”, “Compulsory Evacuation Device”, or a similar card is chained to the equipping effect, “Thousand-Eyes Restrict” must remain face-up on the field to equip the targeted monster. If it is flipped face-down or removed first, the effect does not resolve and the targeted monster remains on the field.

SCO-040.name: Dark Balter the Terrible
SCO-040.effect: A Fusion Summon of this monster can only be conducted with the above Fusion Material Monsters. When a Normal Spell Card is activated, negate the effect by paying 1000 Life Points. The effect of an Effect Monster that this monster destroys as a result of battle is negated.

individual.title: Fusion Material Monster substitutes
individual.text: The first sentence means that monsters such as “Beastking of the Swamps” cannot be used as substitutes for the required Fusion Material Monsters. “Magical Scientist” or “Summoner of Illusions” can still Special Summon this card like any other Fusion Monster.

individual.title: Normal Spell Cards only
individual.text: The effect can only negate Normal Spell Cards, not Quick-Play, Equip, Continuous, Field, or Ritual Spell Cards. It is a Multi-Trigger Effect with Spell Speed 2 and can be activated during the opponent’s turn.

individual.title: Negating an effect instead of an activation
individual.text: This effect negates a Spell Card’s effect when it is activated, not its activation. If “Swords of Revealing Light” is negated this way, it remains meaninglessly on the field for 3 turns and its effect remains negated even if “Dark Balter the Terrible” is later destroyed.

individual.title: Effect Monster negation after battle
individual.text: The effect that negates an Effect Monster destroyed by battle is separate from the Spell Card effect, so no Life Points are paid for it. It works like the effect of “Dark Ruler Ha Des”.

netrep.title: Destroying a monster
netrep.text: “Dark Balter the Terrible” must destroy a monster to negate that monster’s effect.

netrep.title: A destroyed monster leaves the Graveyard
netrep.text: Monsters destroyed by “Dark Balter the Terrible” that leave the Graveyard no longer have their effects negated.

netrep.title: Special Summoning restrictions and Flip Effects
netrep.text: “Dark Balter the Terrible” does not negate Special Summoning restrictions from the Graveyard, including those of “Tyrant Dragon,” “Dark Ruler Ha Des,” and “Helpoemer.” If it destroys a Flip Effect monster, that monster’s Flip Effect is negated.

netrep.title: Marie the Fallen One
netrep.text: If “Dark Balter the Terrible” destroys “Marie the Fallen One” in battle, “Marie the Fallen One”’s Graveyard effect that increases Life Points by 200 each Standby Phase is negated.

netrep.title: Reflect Bounder
netrep.text: If “Dark Balter the Terrible” attacks a face-up Attack Position “Reflect Bounder”, “Reflect Bounder”’s effect that inflicts damage equal to the attacking monster’s ATK is not negated. If “Dark Balter the Terrible” destroys it, “Reflect Bounder” is considered destroyed by battle, not by its own effect.

netrep.title: Sinister Serpent
netrep.text: If “Dark Balter the Terrible” destroys “Sinister Serpent” in battle, its effect that returns it from the Graveyard to the hand during the Standby Phase is negated.

netrep.title: Spirit Reaper
netrep.text: Since “Dark Balter the Terrible” cannot destroy “Spirit Reaper” in battle because of “Spirit Reaper”’s effect, “Spirit Reaper” is neither destroyed nor negated.

netrep.title: Witch of the Black Forest
netrep.text: If “Dark Balter the Terrible” destroys “Witch of the Black Forest”, its effect is negated and it will not receive its searching effect.

questions.title: Attacking a Monster Token
questions.text: If “Dark Balter the Terrible” attacks a Monster Token, it does not stop an effect because the effect comes from the monster that created the Token, not from the Token itself. — Curtis Schultz, 01/25/2004

SCO-043.name: King Dragun
SCO-043.effect:
Lord of D. + Divine Dragon Ragnarok

Your opponent cannot target Dragon monsters with card effects. Once per turn: You can Special Summon 1 Dragon monster from your hand.

individual.title: Effect types
individual.text: The first effect of “King Dragun” is a Continuous Effect. The second effect is an Ignition Effect.

individual.title: De-Fusion
individual.text: Your opponent cannot target a Dragon-Type Fusion Monster with “De-Fusion” while “King Dragun” or “Lord of D.” is on the field because “De-Fusion” targets.

individual.title: Divine Wrath
individual.text: “Divine Wrath” does not target, so it may be used against Dragon-Type monsters while “King Dragun” or “Lord of D.” is on the field.

individual.title: Chaining Divine Wrath
individual.text: You can chain “Divine Wrath” to the effect of “King Dragun” that Special Summons a Dragon-Type monster.

SCO-044.name: Gatling Dragon
SCO-044.effect:
Barrel Dragon + Blowback Dragon

Once per turn: You can toss a coin 3 times and destroy as many monsters on the field as possible, but not more than the number of heads.

individual.title: Destroy as many monsters as possible
individual.text: You must destroy as many monsters as possible based on the number of Heads you flip. If you flip 2 Heads and only your opponent’s monster and your “Gatling Dragon” are on the field, both must be destroyed. If there are only 2 monsters on the field and you flip 3 Heads, destroy both monsters.

individual.title: My Body as a Shield
individual.text: You cannot activate “My Body as a Shield” in a chain to “Gatling Dragon” because it has not yet been decided whether any monster will be destroyed.

SCO-045.name: Fiend Skull Dragon
SCO-045.effect:
Lesser Fiend + Skull Knight

(This card is always treated as an “Archfiend” card.) A Fusion Summon of this card can only be done with the above Fusion Material Monsters. Negate the effects of Flip Effect Monsters. Negate any Trap effects that target this card on the field, and if you do, destroy that Trap Card.

individual.title: Fusion Material Monster substitutes
individual.text: You cannot use substitute Fusion Material Monsters such as “Beastking of the Swamps” to Fusion Summon this card. You can use the effects of “Metamorphosis”, “Magical Scientist”, and “Summoner of Illusions” to Special Summon this card.

individual.title: Fiend Skull Dragon leaves the field
individual.text: If your opponent Flip Summons a monster with a Flip Effect and chains a card such as “Offerings to the Doomed” to destroy “Fiend Skull Dragon”, the Flip Effect is not negated because “Fiend Skull Dragon” is no longer face-up on the field when it resolves.

individual.title: Targeting Trap Cards
individual.text: Your opponent may activate a Trap Card that targets “Fiend Skull Dragon”, but its effect is negated and that Trap Card is destroyed.

individual.title: Trap Cards that do not target
individual.text: “Torrential Tribute”, “Bottomless Trap Hole”, “Mirror Force”, and “Last Turn” all apply their effects to “Fiend Skull Dragon” because they do not target.

individual.title: Call of the Haunted
individual.text: You can activate “Call of the Haunted” to Special Summon “Fiend Skull Dragon”. After it resolves, “Call of the Haunted” is destroyed and “Fiend Skull Dragon” remains on the field. It must have been properly Fusion Summoned previously to be Special Summoned from the Graveyard.

individual.title: Chaining Call of the Haunted
individual.text: You can chain “Call of the Haunted” to the activation of a Flip Effect to Special Summon “Fiend Skull Dragon”, and that Flip Effect is negated.

netrep.title: Leaving the field in a chain
netrep.text: If “Fiend Skull Dragon” is removed from the field in a chain with a Flip Effect, that Flip Effect is not negated by “Fiend Skull Dragon”.

netrep.title: Summoner of Illusions
netrep.text: If “Fiend Skull Dragon” is Special Summoned by the effect of “Summoner of Illusions”, the destruction aspect of “Summoner of Illusions” is negated by “Fiend Skull Dragon”.

questions.title: Archfiend’s Roar
questions.text: If “Fiend Skull Dragon” is Special Summoned by “Archfiend’s Roar”, it does not negate the effect of “Archfiend’s Roar”. It is destroyed by that effect during the End Phase. — Curtis Schultz, 01/25/2004

SCO-046.name: Ryu Senshi
SCO-046.effect:
Warrior Dai Grepher + The Dragon Dwelling in the Cave

A Fusion Summon of this monster can only be conducted with the above Fusion Material Monsters. As long as this card remains face-up on the field, negate the effect of a Normal Trap Card by paying 1000 Life Points. Negate the effects of a Spell Card that targets this card and destroy it.

individual.title: Targeting Spell Cards
individual.text: This card’s effect that negates Spell Cards that target it is not optional.

individual.title: Monster Reborn
individual.text: You can Special Summon this card from the Graveyard with “Monster Reborn” because its Spell Card-negation effect is not active while it is in the Graveyard, but only if it was properly Fusion Summoned originally.

individual.title: Spell Cards that target Ryu Senshi
individual.text: A Spell Card that targets this card may be activated, but it is negated and destroyed.

individual.title: Cards that do not target
individual.text: The effect does not negate “Creature Swap”, “Fissure”, “Smashing Ground”, “Dark Hole”, “Raigeki”, or similar cards that do not target.

individual.title: Fusion Sword Murasame Blade
individual.text: If you try to equip “Fusion Sword Murasame Blade” to this monster, it is negated and destroyed.

netrep.title: Normal Trap Cards only
netrep.text: “Ryu Senshi” may only negate the effect of a Normal Trap Card.

netrep.title: Continuous and Counter Trap Cards
netrep.text: “Ryu Senshi” cannot negate the effect of a Continuous Trap Card or a Counter Trap Card.

SCO-047.name: Reaper on the Nightmare
SCO-047.effect:
Spirit Reaper + Nightmare Horse

This card is not destroyed as a result of battle. Destroy this card when it is targeted by the effect of a Spell, Trap, or Effect Monster. This card can attack your opponent's Life Points directly even if there is a monster on your opponent's side of the field. If this card successfully attacks your opponent's Life Points directly, your opponent discards 1 card randomly from his/her hand.

SCO-049.name: Dark Blade the Dragon Knight
SCO-049.effect:
Dark Blade + Pitch-Dark Dragon

Each time this card inflicts Battle Damage to your opponent, you can select up to 3 Monster Cards from your opponent’s Graveyard and remove them from play.

individual.title: Targeting Monster Cards
individual.text: The effect of “Dark Blade the Dragon Knight” targets up to 3 Monster Cards in the Graveyard, so you select the monsters when the effect is activated.

SCO-050.name: Ojama King
SCO-050.effect:
Ojama Green + Ojama Yellow + Ojama Black

Select up to 3 of your opponent’s Monster Card Zones. The selected zones cannot be used.

individual.title: Occupied Monster Card Zones
individual.text: You cannot select occupied Monster Card Zones with “Ojama King”’s effect. If your opponent has 5 monsters on the field, the effect is not applied.

individual.title: Selecting Monster Card Zones
individual.text: “Ojama King”’s effect activates and you select up to 3 Monster Card Zones when “Ojama King” becomes face-up on the field.

individual.title: Flipping Ojama King face-down
individual.text: If you select up to 3 Monster Card Zones and your “Ojama King” is flipped face-down, the selected zones become usable again. When it is flipped face-up again, you can select up to 3 Monster Card Zones again.

individual.title: Taking control of Ojama King
individual.text: If you take control of your opponent’s face-up “Ojama King”, you cannot select new Monster Card Zones because the zones are selected when “Ojama King” becomes face-up on the field.

SCO-051.name: The Last Warrior from Another Planet
SCO-051.image: images/cards/The Last Warrior from Another Planet.jpg
SCO-051.effect:
Zombyra the Dark + Maryokutai

If this card is Special Summoned: Destroy all other monsters you control. Neither player can Summon monsters.

individual.title: Setting monsters
individual.text: Monsters may still be Set while this card is on the field.

individual.title: Tribute Summons
individual.text: This card may be Tributed to Tribute Summon a Level 5 or higher monster.

individual.title: Cards that cannot be activated
individual.text: Neither player can activate “Scapegoat”, “Magical Hats”, “Monster Reborn”, and similar cards.

individual.title: Parasite Paracide
individual.text: If your “Parasite Paracide” in your opponent’s Deck is drawn, it is not Special Summoned. It is destroyed and sent to your Graveyard instead, and no damage is dealt.

netrep.title: Special Summons
netrep.text: As long as “The Last Warrior from Another Planet” is active, neither player may Special Summon a monster.

netrep.title: Flipping monsters
netrep.text: The effect only prevents Summons. It does not prevent monsters from being flipped by other means.

questions.title: The Shallow Grave
questions.text: “The Shallow Grave” is a Special Summon. Neither player can Special Summon any monsters while “The Last Warrior from Another Planet” is face-up on the field. — Curtis Schultz, 02/12/2004

questions.title: Fusion and Ritual Summons
questions.text: Fusion Summons and Ritual Summons are Special Summons, so neither may be performed while “The Last Warrior from Another Planet” is face-up on the field. — Curtis Schultz, 02/12/2004

SCO-052.name: Gravekeeper’s Spy
SCO-052.effect: FLIP: Special Summon 1 "Gravekeeper’s" monster with 1500 or less ATK from your Deck.

individual.title: Necrovalley and ATK
individual.text: You can Special Summon a Gravekeeper’s monster whose ATK becomes higher than 1500 after it is Summoned. For example, with “Necrovalley” in play, you can Special Summon another “Gravekeeper’s Spy” even though its ATK becomes 1700 on the field.

SCO-053.name: Thunder Dragon
SCO-053.effect: You can discard this card; add up to 2 "Thunder Dragon" from your Deck to your hand.

individual.title: Banisher of the Light
individual.text: You can discard “Thunder Dragon” to activate its effect even if it would not be sent to your Graveyard, such as while “Banisher of the Light” is face-up on the field.

individual.title: An opponent’s Thunder Dragon
individual.text: If you have your opponent’s “Thunder Dragon” in your hand because of “Exchange”, you can discard it to activate its effect and add up to 2 “Thunder Dragon” from your Deck to your hand.

individual.title: Thunder Dragons already in the Graveyard
individual.text: You can discard “Thunder Dragon” to activate its effect even if you already have 2 “Thunder Dragon” in your Graveyard.

netrep.title: Activated effect
netrep.text: “Thunder Dragon’s” effect is an activated effect.

netrep.title: Searching zero copies
netrep.text: “Thunder Dragon” may be discarded to add 0 “Thunder Dragon” from the player’s Deck to their hand.

netrep.title: Discarded by another effect
netrep.text: The effect of “Thunder Dragon” may not be activated if it is discarded through another effect.

SCO-054.name: Chaos Sorcerer
SCO-054.effect: Cannot be Normal Summoned/Set. Must first be Special Summoned (from your hand) by banishing 1 LIGHT and 1 DARK monster from your GY. Once per turn: You can target 1 face-up monster on the field; banish that target. This card cannot attack the turn you activate this effect.

individual.title: Activation timing
individual.text: You can only activate “Chaos Sorcerer’s” effect during Main Phase 1 or Main Phase 2 of your turn.

individual.title: Once per turn
individual.text: You can only activate “Chaos Sorcerer’s” effect once per turn.

individual.title: Attacking first
individual.text: If “Chaos Sorcerer” attacks, you cannot use its effect during Main Phase 2. If it did not attack, you can activate its effect in Main Phase 2.

individual.title: Book of Moon
individual.text: If you target a face-up monster with “Chaos Sorcerer’s” effect and “Book of Moon” is chained to flip that monster face-down, the effect disappears. The effect was still activated, so “Chaos Sorcerer” cannot attack or activate its effect again that turn.

individual.title: Magic Cylinder
individual.text: If “Chaos Sorcerer” attacks and the attack is negated with “Magic Cylinder”, it cannot activate its effect in Main Phase 2.

individual.title: Replay
individual.text: If “Chaos Sorcerer” attacks, a replay occurs, and you choose not to attack again, it cannot activate its effect in Main Phase 2.

SCO-055.name: Dekoichi the Battlechanted Locomotive
SCO-055.effect: FLIP: Draw 1 card, then draw 1 additional card for each face-up “Bokoichi the Freightening Car” you control.

individual.title: Controlled Bokoichi
individual.text: The effect of “Dekoichi the Battlechanted Locomotive” includes any of your opponent’s “Bokoichi the Freightening Car” that you control on your side of the field.

individual.title: Counting on resolution
individual.text: The number of “Bokoichi the Freightening Car” on your side of the field is counted when this card’s effect resolves. If it is flipped and “Ring of Destruction” is chained to destroy the only “Bokoichi the Freightening Car” you control, you draw only 1 card.

SCO-056.name: Magician of Faith
SCO-056.effect: FLIP: Target 1 Spell in your GY; add that target to your hand.

SCO-057.name: Sangan
SCO-057.effect: If this card is sent from the field to the Graveyard: Add 1 monster with 1500 or less ATK from your Deck to your hand.

individual.title: Revealing the selected monster
individual.text: You must show your opponent the monster you select from your Deck for this card’s effect. If you have no eligible monsters, your opponent gets to see your Deck to verify.

individual.title: Sent from the field
individual.text: The effect of “Sangan” only activates when it is sent from the field to the Graveyard, not from your hand or Deck, and not if it is banished.

individual.title: Negated Summon
individual.text: If this card’s Summon is negated with “Horn of Heaven” or “Solemn Judgment”, you do not get its effect.

individual.title: Your opponent’s Sangan
individual.text: If you control your opponent’s “Sangan” and it is destroyed, your opponent gets the effect because it activates in their Graveyard.

individual.title: Chaining
individual.text: You can chain to “Sangan’s” effect.

SCO-058.name: Sinister Serpent
SCO-058.effect: During your Standby Phase, if this card is in your Graveyard: You can return it to your hand.

individual.title: Optional effect
individual.text: The effect of this card is optional; you do not have to return it to your hand.

individual.title: How it is sent to the Graveyard
individual.text: The effect of this card activates no matter how it is sent to the Graveyard. It can be destroyed, Tributed, discarded from the hand, or sent directly from the Deck to the Graveyard.

individual.title: Destroyed during the Standby Phase
individual.text: If your “Sinister Serpent” is on the field and is destroyed during your Standby Phase, you may return it to your hand during that same Standby Phase.

individual.title: Dark Ruler Ha Des and Dark Balter the Terrible
individual.text: If “Sinister Serpent” is destroyed in battle by “Dark Ruler Ha Des” or “Dark Balter the Terrible”, you cannot activate its effect to return it to your hand during your next Standby Phase or any later Standby Phase.

individual.title: The End of Anubis
individual.text: You cannot activate the effect of “Sinister Serpent” if “The End of Anubis” is on the field.

individual.title: Necrovalley
individual.text: “Necrovalley” does not negate the effect of “Sinister Serpent”.

SCO-059.name: Night Assailant
SCO-059.effect: FLIP: Select 1 monster on your opponent’s side of the field and destroy it. When this card is sent directly from your hand to the Graveyard, return 1 Flip Effect Monster from your Graveyard to your hand.

individual.title: Discarding as a cost
individual.text: “Night Assailant” does not have to be sent to the Graveyard by an effect or an effect controlled by your opponent; it only has to be sent to the Graveyard. Its effect activates when sent as a cost for “Magic Jammer” or “Tribe-Infecting Virus”, after the current Chain resolves.

individual.title: Morphing Jar and Card Destruction
individual.text: “Night Assailant”’s effect activates when it is sent to the Graveyard by “Morphing Jar” or “Card Destruction”.

individual.title: Ritual Summons
individual.text: “Night Assailant”’s effect activates when it is sent to the Graveyard for a Ritual Summon.

individual.title: Last Turn
individual.text: When “Night Assailant” is sent to the Graveyard by “Last Turn”, first resolve “Last Turn” by sending all cards on the field and in the hands to the Graveyard, then activate and resolve “Night Assailant”’s effect, then Special Summon a monster by “Last Turn”.

individual.title: No infinite loop
individual.text: You cannot select the “Night Assailant” that was itself sent to the Graveyard, so there is no infinite loop.

individual.title: Multiple Night Assailants
individual.text: When multiple “Night Assailants” are sent to the Graveyard at the same time by “Graceful Charity” or a similar effect, both can return to your hand because each cannot select itself but can select a different “Night Assailant”, including one sent to the Graveyard at the same time.

individual.title: Targeting
individual.text: Both of “Night Assailant”’s effects target.

individual.title: Necrovalley
individual.text: You cannot use “Night Assailant”’s second effect while “Necrovalley” is active.

individual.title: An opponent’s hand
