individual.text: If your opponent has your “Night Assailant” in their hand because of “Exchange” and it is sent to the Graveyard, you, the owner, get the effect.

individual.title: Forced Requisition loop
individual.text: If “Forced Requisition” is active and you discard “Night Assailant” at the End Phase because you have 7 cards in hand while another “Night Assailant” is in your Graveyard, your opponent discards for “Forced Requisition”. You can then retrieve the other “Night Assailant” and repeat this process until your opponent has no cards in hand.

SCO-060.name: Card Destruction
SCO-060.effect: Both players discard as many cards as possible from their hands, then each player draws the same number of cards they discarded.

individual.title: Discarding is not a cost
individual.text: Discarding your hand is not a cost for either player.

netrep.title: Cards outside their owner’s hand
netrep.text: If any cards are not in their owner’s hand through “Exchange” or a similar effect when “Card Destruction” is played, the owners of those cards may decide the order in which the cards go to the Graveyard.

netrep.title: Activation cost
netrep.text: Cards discarded for “Card Destruction” are not a cost of activating “Card Destruction”.

netrep.title: Banisher of the Light
netrep.text: If “Card Destruction” resolves while “Banisher of the Light” is active on the field, each player still draws the same number of cards that were discarded.

netrep.title: When it can be activated
netrep.text: “Card Destruction” can be activated if either player has at least 1 card in their hand, not including “Card Destruction”. If your opponent has 1 or more cards and you only have “Card Destruction”, you can activate it. If your opponent has no cards and you have “Card Destruction” plus 1 other card, you can activate it. If your opponent has no cards and “Card Destruction” is your only card, you cannot activate it.

SCO-061.name: Raigeki Break
SCO-061.effect: Discard 1 card, then target 1 card on the field; destroy it.

SCO-062.name: Kinetic Soldier
SCO-062.effect: If this card battles a Warrior-Type monster, during damage calculation: This card gains 2000 ATK and DEF during that damage calculation only.

netrep.title: Battle with a Warrior-Type monster
netrep.text: “Kinetic Soldier’s” effect activates when it is in battle with a Warrior-Type monster.

SCO-063.name: Tribe-Infecting Virus
SCO-063.effect: Discard 1 card from your hand and declare 1 Type of monster. Destroy all face-up monsters of the declared Type on the field.

individual.title: Declaring a Type
individual.text: You declare the Type and discard for the cost when you activate the effect, not when it resolves. Your opponent can chain after you announce which Type will be destroyed.

individual.title: Available Types
individual.text: You can declare a Type that exists only on your opponent’s side of the field. You cannot declare a Type that is not face-up on the field at all.

individual.title: Repeated activations
individual.text: You can use this effect repeatedly as long as you can keep paying the cost.

questions.title: DNA Surgery
questions.text: If “Tribe-Infecting Virus” declares a Type and “DNA Surgery” is chained to declare a different Type, the declared Type no longer exists on the field. The effect of “Tribe-Infecting Virus” disappears and the monster is not destroyed. — Curtis Schultz, 01/12/2004

SCO-064.name: Upstart Goblin
SCO-064.effect: Draw 1 card, then your opponent gains 1000 LP.

SCO-065.name: Tsukuyomi
SCO-065.effect: Cannot be Special Summoned. If this card is Normal Summoned or flipped face-up: Target 1 face-up monster on the field; change that target to face-down Defense Position. Once per turn, during the End Phase, if this card was Normal Summoned or flipped face-up this turn: Return it to the hand.

individual.title: Targeting itself
individual.text: You can select “Tsukuyomi” itself as the target of its effect, but not when “Tsukuyomi” was flipped face-up by an attack and destroyed by damage calculation.

netrep.title: Mandatory effect
netrep.text: “Tsukuyomi’s” effect is mandatory.

SCO-067.name: Swords of Revealing Light
SCO-067.effect: Flip all face-down monsters on your opponent’s side of the field face-up. This card remains face-up on the field for 3 of your opponent’s turns. As long as this card remains face-up on the field, your opponent cannot declare an attack.

individual.title: Duration
individual.text: This card remains active on the field until the end of your opponent’s third turn. It must remain on the field for its effect to apply.

individual.title: Removed from the field
individual.text: If this card is destroyed or removed from the field by another card effect, such as “Heavy Storm” or “Giant Trunade”, your opponent may attack again.

individual.title: Multiple Flip Effects
individual.text: When multiple Flip Effect monsters are flipped face-up by this effect, their effects activate simultaneously and follow the simultaneous-effects rules.

individual.title: Imperial Order
individual.text: You can activate this card while “Imperial Order” is active. It keeps its turn count, but does not flip monsters face-up or prevent attacks while its effect is negated. If “Imperial Order” is destroyed after two of your opponent’s turns, it prevents attacks for the remaining turn before being destroyed.

netrep.title: Destroyed during activation
netrep.text: If this card is destroyed, but its activation is not negated in the same chain, it still flips all monsters on your opponent’s field face-up.

netrep.title: Expiration
netrep.text: When this card’s effect expires, it is sent to the Graveyard even if its effect is being negated.
